faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Govt. Raja Mirasudhar Hospital recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Govt. Raja Mirasudhar Hospital Audiologist cum Speech Therapist recruitment is 28 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Audiologist cum Speech Therapist.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Audiologist cum Speech Therapist.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is a Bachelor’s Degree in Audiology and Speech Language Pathology (BASLP) from a recognized university or institution.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 32,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Government Raja Mirasudhar Hospital Thanjavur, which is https://thanjavur.nic.in/.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Contractual.
